hero.name: Sabrina Suppa
hero.bgAlt: Sculptural form in dark, cinematic light

about.bio: Sabrina Suppa is a sculptor working across digital and physical media. Her practice sits at the threshold between flesh and machinery — porcelain whites, oxidized graphite, silicone skin tones — building forms that feel at once clinical and intimate.
about.statement: I am interested in the seam where the body meets its replacements. Each work is a study of transformation through pain and repair — marble emerging from rough stone, cracks glowing with golden light. The surgical and the sacred are not opposites; they are the same gesture seen from different distances.
about.bgAlt: Sculptural form behind layered vertical blur bands
